notes: All three Mount Hood areas share one Peakbagger record; every harvested track is a Timberline south-side ascent. No track assigned to any of the three routes. Tracks 3247306/3203959/3228175 have no route name and could fit the existing South Side (Hogsback) route (which already has a track). 2850250 has corrupt elevations (3 m) and is not usable. Newton Clark Headwall, Sunshine and West Crater Rim have no trailhead pins; no trailhead proposed because no track nominates Cloud Cap/Tilly Jane/Meadows. Missing routes are listed in or_east_side_2.json only.
